name: MAGLEV STATION PLATFORM
text: The station stretches before you, a testament
to enduring transit systems. Signs for Maglev
and Express Line glow steadily above rows of
waiting benches.

name: TRACK TRENCH WALLS
text: Sturdy metal paneling lines the trench where
the maglev once hovered. The structure remains
intact despite the passage of time.

name: TRENCH WALL PIPING
text: A long, continuous pipe runs along the upper
edge of the track trench. Its metal surface is
dull but free of major damage.

name: TRENCH DRAINAGE GRATES
text: Industrial grates cover the lower section of
the track trench wall. They likely once housed
sensors or drainage systems for the transit
line.

name: LOWER ROOFTOP AC
text: A heavy air conditioning unit sits on the roof
below the platform level. Thick pipes connect
it to the main station structure.

name: LUMINESCENT COOLANT TRENCH
text: A pool of vibrant, cyan liquid fills the
bottom of the transit trench. It casts a
bright, unnatural glow upward onto the
platform edge.

name: LOWER ROOFTOP AC
text: Another industrial air conditioner rests on
the lower rooftop, mirroring the one across
the gap. Its fan blades are still, gathering
dust.

name: LOWER PLATFORM RAILING
text: A simple metal railing runs along the edge of
the lower platform area. It provides a safety
barrier above the station's lower workings.

name: LOWER PLATFORM RAILING
text: This section of metal railing borders the
lower rooftop on the right side. It's a
standard safety feature for maintenance
access.

name: TRANSIT MAP DISPLAY
text: A digital screen displays a glowing, schematic
map of the transit lines. The cyan lines
branch and intersect, showing routes that
might still be active.

name: LOWER PLATFORM FLOORING
text: The concrete surface of the lower platform is
stained and worn. It serves as an access level
below the main passenger area.

name: STATION VENDING MACHINE
text: A brightly lit vending machine offers a
selection of colorful canned drinks. The
display remains active, a small convenience in
the cavernous station.

name: ROOFTOP PIPING
text: A thick, angled pipe snakes across the lower
rooftop near the air conditioner. It's part of
the station's underlying infrastructure.

name: DEPARTURE SCHEDULE BOARD
text: An old-style electronic board lists departure
times in bright green and amber text. The data
flickers slightly, cycling through outdated
schedules.
